title: 矽穿孔背面露出
summary: 以 12 個技術單元、24 步分析與驗證深入薄化終點、選擇比與露出均勻性。逐一建立剖面、測試見證、失效判別和可審查的驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units and 24 analysis/verification steps explore thinning endpoint, selectivity and reveal uniformity, building sections, test witnesses, failure discrimination and reviewable acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開工程原理與原創教學推理；數值是明示假設的算例，不是生產配方或供應商規格。各單元先建立物理模型，再設計能區分失效機制的量測。24 步是學習工作包，完整量產需經授權設備、材料及產品資格驗證。
scopeEn: Public engineering principles and original educational reasoning. Numbers are explicitly hypothetical examples, not production recipes or supplier specifications. Each unit builds a physical model then measurements that discriminate failure mechanisms. The 24 steps are learning work packages; production requires qualified equipment, materials and product validation.

stages.title: 深度與支撐
stages.description: 針對深度與支撐完成三個專屬技術單元；每個單元包含物理分析與量測診斷兩步。
stages.descriptionEn: Three dedicated units for depth and support, each with physical analysis and measurement diagnosis.

steps.title: 深度座標｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對深度座標，把「TSV 深度與背面厚度必須共用原始正面基準。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For depth coordinates, turn "TSV depth and backside thickness need a common frontside datum." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「深度座標」的模型：TSV 深度與背面厚度必須共用原始正面基準。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「統一圖面和量測零點。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for depth coordinates: TSV depth and backside thickness need a common frontside datum. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Unify design and metrology zero references. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 統一圖面和量測零點。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Unify design and metrology zero references. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：兩個深度數值相減不需檢查基準。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Subtracting depths without checking datums. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付深度座標的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。
steps.checkEn: Submit a section/causal diagram for depth coordinates, a two-case comparison and one falsifying measurement; include units, datums and upstream/downstream interfaces.

knowledge.title: 深度座標：機制
knowledge.text: TSV 深度與背面厚度必須共用原始正面基準。
knowledge.textEn: TSV depth and backside thickness need a common frontside datum.

knowledge.title: 量測與錯判分辨
knowledge.text: 統一圖面和量測零點。 必須排除的錯判：兩個深度數值相減不需檢查基準。量測解析度、重複性與系統偏差分別列示；不同方法看到的範圍不可默認相同。
knowledge.textEn: Unify design and metrology zero references. Misinterpretation to reject: Subtracting depths without checking datums. Report resolution, repeatability and systematic bias separately; different methods do not automatically cover the same domain.

quiz.question: 在「深度座標」的機制與設計中，哪一項判斷或行動有充分依據？
quiz.questionEn: For depth coordinates — mechanism and design — which decision or action is justified?
options: TSV 深度與背面厚度必須共用原始正面基準。
兩個深度數值相減不需檢查基準
高矽蝕刻速率就是高選擇比
optionsEn: TSV depth and backside thickness need a common frontside datum.
Equating fast Si removal with high selectivity
quiz.explanation: TSV 深度與背面厚度必須共用原始正面基準。 統一圖面和量測零點。 因此不能採用「兩個深度數值相減不需檢查基準」。
quiz.explanationEn: TSV depth and backside thickness need a common frontside datum. Unify design and metrology zero references. Therefore reject: Subtracting depths without checking datums.

steps.title: 深度座標｜證據與診斷
steps.objective: 針對深度座標，把「TSV 深度與背面厚度必須共用原始正面基準。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For depth coordinates, turn "TSV depth and backside thickness need a common frontside datum." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 以先前模型進行證據審查：統一圖面和量測零點。 將「兩個深度數值相減不需檢查基準」當作待否定假說，另提出一項可能造成相同表象的混淆因素。安排對照樣本、座標和重複量測，分開記錄觀察值與機制推論；指出哪個結果會讓你暫停放行。
steps.instructionEn: Review the preceding model with evidence: Unify design and metrology zero references. Challenge the hypothesis "Subtracting depths without checking datums" and name another mechanism that could give the same appearance. Plan controls, sampling coordinates and repeated measurements; separate observations from inference and identify a hold condition.
steps.observation: 統一圖面和量測零點。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Unify design and metrology zero references. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：兩個深度數值相減不需檢查基準。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。
steps.failureEn: Avoid: Subtracting depths without checking datums. Check for mixed references, missed local variation or extrapolation before using this unit’s measurements to distinguish mechanisms.
steps.check: 交付深度座標的證據表：原始觀察、兩個競爭假說、對照方法、不確定度與接受／暫緩條件；至少一項證據須獨立於主要讀值。
steps.checkEn: Submit evidence for depth coordinates: observations, two competing hypotheses, controls, uncertainty and accept/hold criteria, including one observation independent of the main reading.

steps.title: 來料 TTV｜機制與設計
steps.objective: 針對來料 TTV，把「全片厚度分布決定最早和最晚露出區。」轉成可驗證的工程判定，明確列出適用範圍與未知量。
steps.objectiveEn: For incoming ttv, turn "Thickness distribution determines earliest/latest reveal sites." into a testable engineering decision with explicit bounds and unknowns.
steps.instruction: 本步先建立「來料 TTV」的模型：全片厚度分布決定最早和最晚露出區。 在剖面或資料表中標出控制量、受影響量和交接介面；提出一組只改一項條件的比較，寫出預測方向。用「將 TTV 與 TSV 深度地圖配準。」規劃模型將如何被推翻；不要把畫得合理當作已經實測。
steps.instructionEn: Build the model for incoming ttv: Thickness distribution determines earliest/latest reveal sites. Mark controlled quantities, responses and handoff interfaces in a section or data table. Compare two cases changing one condition and predict direction. Use this evidence plan: Register TTV and via-depth maps. State how the model could be falsified; a plausible drawing is not a measurement.
steps.observation: 將 TTV 與 TSV 深度地圖配準。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
steps.observationEn: Register TTV and via-depth maps. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.
steps.failure: 避免：平均厚度達標即所有 TSV 同步露出。先檢查是否混用基準、忽略局部差異或超出模型範圍，再以本單元量測區分機制。

steps.check: 交付來料 TTV的剖面或因果圖、兩組條件比較及一項可否定預測的量測；標出單位、基準與前後站接口。

quiz.explanation: 背面加工載荷需由前側支撐承受且避免位移。 檢查膠層空洞及前後位移。 因此不能採用「載板剛性高即可忽略膠層」。
quiz.explanationEn: Frontside support carries backside loads without shift. Inspect adhesive voids and displacement. Therefore reject: Ignoring adhesive because the carrier is stiff.
